title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
summary: Rebuild the binary tree described by two traversal arrays.

contractDetails.constraints: Each array has the same length from 1 to 3,000 and contains the same distinct integers in [−3,000, 3,000]. The traversals are guaranteed to describe a valid tree.

statement: Rebuild the binary tree described by two traversal arrays. Preorder visits root, left, then right. Inorder visits left, root, then right. Return the root of a tree that produces both supplied arrays.

examples.explanation: The inorder sequence places 6 on the right of 4.
Every successive node is a left child.

constraints: Each array has the same length from 1 to 3,000 and contains the same distinct integers in [−3,000, 3,000]. The traversals are guaranteed to describe a valid tree.
hints: Conceptual: The first preorder value is the root, and its inorder position separates the two subtrees.
Directional: A stack can track ancestors whose inorder turn has not arrived.

Implementation: For each new preorder node, attach it to the left of the top while that top differs from the next inorder value. Otherwise pop matching ancestors and attach the new node on the right of the last one popped.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(h) auxiliary space excluding the new tree, using an explicit stack.
